build_frozen_encoder_model: build a frozen pytorch encoder model from a pretrained checkpoint for image classification
init_module_from_checkpoint: init a frozen model module from a pretrained checkpoint with specified resolution and device
load_encoder_for_inference: load an encoder module in eval mode with all parameters frozen for inference
configure_model_with_kwargs: configure a model with model_kwargs and wrapper_kwargs during initialization
freeze_model_parameters: freeze all model parameters after loading a pretrained encoder for fine-tuning prevention
